title: Make Clippy non-blocking in Engram's gates: an early blocking compile check, an early Clippy whose findings are reported and fixed next round
outcome: Report Clippy findings without blocking check-in or landing; run an early blocking compile check and preserve blocking builds and tests.
acceptance: scripts/test-launcher.mjs runs cargo check --all-targets --all-features early as a blocking step, and cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format=json -- --cap-lints warn early with native exits unchanged. Clippy warning findings are reported with locations in the run result, do not fail the gate, and let tests continue; compiler, deny/forbid errors in the uncapped check and spawn/tool failures remain blocking.

AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, kept identical, both existing coder-test-execution skill twins, .claude/commands/review-changes.md, the engram-repo gate example and docs/development.md carry exact agreed V3: Clippy warnings do not block check-in or landing, are recorded and assigned for next-round fixes, while compile/build/test/tool failures still block. Kimi agrees the reconciliation and authority-text (a), (b) and final-diff audit (c) apply, with Greg's verbatim widening word recorded.

Behavioral launcher tests show a located Clippy warning is reported without failing the gate while later tests execute, and compile/tool failures still block. The actual toolchain's deny-level Clippy lint becomes warning with native exit0 under the capped command, while uncapped compiler/deny failures block. No test reads Markdown.
